messages.subject: DISTANCE sampling used in legal context ?
parts:
> >Dear colleagues,
> >
> >I hope you don't mind that I ask a non-technical question:
> >
> >I am looking for references which have used scientific based wildlife
> >studies in court cases.
> >Specifically, I am interested in DISTANCE sampling and also GIS modelling
> >approaches, and how they got accepted in a legal context.
> >
> >I think some of the Spotted Owl papers have been used in U.S. court cases.
> >
> >I learnt recently from my colleagues that scientific and significant
> >results do not always matter to judges and lawyers, so I would be very
> >curious to learn how to improve that, and how to make population
> >assessments and multivariate GIS models
> >'legally waterproof'.
> >
> >Thanks in advance and best regards
> >
> > Falk
